docs.title: national championship 1996
docs.text: Florida won its first football national championship after the 1996 season, beating Florida State 52-20 in the Sugar Bowl on Jan. 2, 1997, under head coach Steve Spurrier. Danny Wuerffel was the quarterback.

docs.title: national championship 2006
docs.text: Florida won the 2006 BCS National Championship, beating Ohio State 41-14 on Jan. 8, 2007, in Glendale, Ariz., in Urban Meyer's second season. Chris Leak was the starting quarterback and Tim Tebow was a freshman.

docs.title: national championship 2008
docs.text: Florida won the 2008 BCS National Championship, beating Oklahoma 24-14 on Jan. 8, 2009, in Miami. Tim Tebow was the quarterback and Urban Meyer the head coach. It is Florida's third and most recent football national title.

docs.title: Heisman Trophy Steve Spurrier 1966
docs.text: Steve Spurrier won the Heisman Trophy in 1966 as Florida's quarterback, the program's first Heisman winner.

docs.title: Heisman Trophy Danny Wuerffel 1996
docs.text: Danny Wuerffel won the Heisman Trophy in 1996, the same season Florida won its first national championship.

docs.title: Heisman Trophy Tim Tebow 2007
docs.text: Tim Tebow won the Heisman Trophy in 2007 as a sophomore, the first sophomore to win the award. Florida's three Heisman winners are Steve Spurrier (1966), Danny Wuerffel (1996) and Tim Tebow (2007).

docs.title: SEC championships football
docs.text: Florida's football SEC championships recognized by the school: 1991, 1993, 1994, 1995, 1996, 2000, 2006 and 2008. Steve Spurrier won six, Urban Meyer won two.

docs.title: Steve Spurrier head coach
docs.text: Steve Spurrier was Florida's head football coach from 1990 through 2001, going 122-27-1 with six SEC titles and the 1996 national championship. He nicknamed Ben Hill Griffin Stadium 'The Swamp' in 1992.

docs.title: Urban Meyer head coach
docs.text: Urban Meyer coached Florida from 2005 through 2010 and won two national championships (2006 and 2008 seasons).

docs.title: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium The Swamp
docs.text: Florida plays home games at Ben Hill Griffin Stadium at Florida Field in Gainesville, known as The Swamp. The stadium opened in 1930; the school lists capacity at 88,548.

docs.title: mascots colors nickname
docs.text: Florida's teams are the Gators. The colors are orange and blue and the costumed mascots are Albert and Alberta. The fight song is 'The Orange and Blue' and the alma mater is 'We Are the Boys from Old Florida.'

docs.title: rivals Georgia Florida State Tennessee LSU
docs.text: Florida's main football rivalries are Georgia (played in Jacksonville), Florida State (the season finale) and Tennessee, with LSU and Miami also long-standing rivals.

docs.title: basketball national championships 2006 2007
docs.text: Florida men's basketball won back-to-back NCAA national championships in 2006 and 2007 under Billy Donovan, the first repeat champion since Duke in 1991-92.

docs.title: basketball national championship 2025
docs.text: Florida men's basketball won the 2025 NCAA national championship under Todd Golden, beating Houston 65-63 in San Antonio on April 7, 2025, the program's third title.

docs.title: first football season founding
docs.text: Florida fielded its first football team in 1906. The university joined the Southeastern Conference as a charter member in 1932.
